description: The graph illustrates the accuracy (%) of various models as a function of the number of frames, with the x-axis representing the number of frames on a linear scale ranging from 10 to 65, and the y-axis showing accuracy from 40% to 54%. The plot compares four models: "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" (blue circles), "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" (green circles), "PLLAVA (DP 8)" (orange squares), and "PLLAVA (DP 16)" (red squares). The "Ours (Dynamic Seg)" and "Ours (Static 4-Seg)" models exhibit high accuracy, starting at approximately 53% and 52.5% respectively at 10 frames, increasing to around 54% by 15 frames, and then remaining relatively stable near 54% for the rest of the range. In contrast, the "PLLAVA (DP 8)" model begins at about 45.5% and shows a steady decline to approximately 39.5% at 65 frames. The "PLLAVA (DP 16)" model starts at roughly 45.8% and decreases to about 42.3% over the same range. The legend in the upper right corner identifies each model with its corresponding color and marker style.
